scope: Bounded Docker mutation deadlines, durable named creation reconciliation and conservative recovery of legacy never-started candidates

source.definition: Sorted tracked and nonignored untracked JS/Python/config/HTML/CSS/Markdown sources; path + NUL + LF-normalized UTF-8 + NUL. Deployment evidence subdirectories excluded.

regressions: Actual HTTP server creates a container after its client response times out; only one POST is sent and the original result is recovered
Wrong nonce, started, referenced, mounted, privileged, changed or unverified legacy resources are retained
Unknown outcomes survive service restart and history trimming; absent unknown creates are not silently discarded
Environment values are excluded from mutation records
Legacy candidates require a newer verified worker boot and retained failed release identity
